lead.headline: The Ravens claim missed; the Patriots are free
lead.deck: Your defence is still on bye. Add the Patriots, drop the Vikings — no claim needed. Everything else is set.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. The Ravens' defence went to Bok-aneers when claims ran at 01:54, and the Chiefs to Footballers; you are still 2nd in the order, which says your claim was probably never placed. So the Vikings, on bye, are still your only defence at 0.0. The fix is now free: the Patriots' defence is a free agent, the best on your wire at 7.7, at home to a Jets offence whose quarterback has been sacked at least three times in each of his last four games. Add them and drop the Vikings before anyone else does; the Jets are the fallback. The rest of the lineup is the projection lineup. Coker's first official practice report comes this afternoon; if he is inactive at 09:30 Sunday, Kamara takes the flex. Next week Allen, Tuten and McLaurin are on bye.
